description: This file defines the ConnectionFactory interface in Java, specifying methods for obtaining and closing database connections within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing database connections within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection using the provided helper info and JDBC configuration, may throw SQLException or GenericEntityException.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.description: Closes all database connections managed by the implementing class.
